headline.zh: 为AI代理构建持久化工作流
headline.en: Build durable workflows for AI agents

scenario.zh: 电商平台需要AI代理处理订单异常,即使遇到故障也能自动恢复执行
scenario.en: E-commerce platform needs AI agents handling order exceptions with automatic recovery from failures

instruction.zh: 决定代理如何处理长时间运行的订单审核任务
instruction.en: Decide how agents handle long-running order review tasks

output.zh: 需要手动编写重试逻辑、状态存储和错误恢复代码
output.en: Requires manual retry logic, state storage and error recovery code

output.zh: 自动处理状态持久化和故障恢复,代码更简洁
output.en: Automatic state persistence and failure recovery, cleaner code

instruction.zh: 设定AI代理如何调用外部支付和库存系统
instruction.en: Set how AI agents call external payment and inventory systems

output.zh: 网络超时导致订单状态不一致,需要人工介入修复
output.en: Network timeouts cause order state inconsistency, requires manual fixes

output.zh: 调用结果自动缓存,超时后从断点继续,无需重复执行
output.en: Call results auto-cached, resumes from checkpoint after timeout, no re-execution

instruction.zh: 观察代理在数据库故障后的恢复表现
instruction.en: Observe agent recovery performance after database failure

output.zh: 工作流从头重新开始,已完成的支付验证步骤被重复执行
output.en: Workflow restarts from beginning, completed payment verification step re-runs

output.zh: 工作流从故障点精确恢复,只执行未完成的库存检查步骤
output.en: Workflow resumes exactly from failure point, only runs pending inventory check

instruction.zh: 检查代理处理的订单异常记录和状态追踪
instruction.en: Check order exception records and state tracking handled by agent

output.zh: 代理在两次重启后完成审核,所有中间状态已保留,无数据丢失
output.en: Agent completed review after two restarts, all intermediate state preserved, no data loss

output.zh: 代理暂停等待人工批准后自动恢复,工作流状态完整保持
output.en: Agent paused for manual approval then auto-resumed, workflow state fully maintained

takeaway.zh: Restate为AI代理提供内置的持久执行能力,简化故障恢复和状态管理的复杂性
takeaway.en: Restate provides built-in durable execution for AI agents, simplifying failure recovery and state management complexity
